newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS TUESDAY MIXED ON HARD UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS TUESDAY MIXED ON HARD UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted easier against the key U.S. unit and sterling but firmer against the mark and the rand after a fairly active Tuesday interbank session, dealers said.
"The market closed rather short (of foreign currency). The central (Reserve) bank came in to buy some U.S. dollars and a couple of banks were also buying from the market," one dealer said.

He said the local currency finished the day at 11.3300/3400 against the U.S. dollar from Monday's 11.3140/3240 and was at 18.9075/9150 from 18.8360/8580 against sterling, tracking a weaker U.S. dollar overseas in the case of the latter
It was however firmer on the mark at 6.5675/5795 compared to 6.5720/5790 and against the rand at 2.5090/5195 versus 2.5170/5180.
